full_prompt_en: A square expressionist oil portrait shows a thin middle-aged man from the chest up before a crowded, weathered wall. A low dark brimmed hat sits over short hair and casts a shadow on his deeply lined forehead. He looks slightly upward and to the left, blue-gray eyes open wide, with a narrow mustache and tense closed mouth. His long face is modeled in ocher, gray-blue, and pale cream strokes, and the cheekbones, nose, and ears are sharply emphasized. A dark coat covers the shoulders, with a cream shirt and narrow tie visible at the center below the neck. The coat fades into near-black at the lower corners, concentrating the viewer's attention on the angular head. Behind him, layered marks in tan, blue, copper, and faded green curl and knot across the wall like old paint, stone, and smoke. The texture is especially active around the upper corners and beside the hat, while the face retains more coherent planes despite its visible brushwork. Light reaches the face from the upper left, lifting the left brow and nose and leaving the right cheek under deeper cooler shade. The background has no clear room or horizon, only a shallow, densely worked surface that seems close behind the sitter. Scraped lines, small patches of impasto, and transparent rubbed passages give the image a restless handmade quality. The portrait is frontal enough to feel confrontational, but the off-center gaze pulls attention beyond the frame. The overall composition is psychologically taut, with the still dark-clad figure surrounded by unstable color and curling line.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形表现主义油画半身肖像描绘一位清瘦中年男子站在笔痕密集、饱经风化的墙前。低低的深色有檐帽压在短发上，在布满深纹的额头投影。他略向左上看，蓝灰眼睛睁大，细窄胡须在紧闭嘴唇上方。长脸由赭、灰蓝和浅奶油色笔触塑成，颧骨、鼻子和耳朵特别突出。深色外套包住肩膀，奶油色衬衣和细领带在脖子下方中央可见。外套在下方两角淡入近黑，让观者注意棱角分明的头部。身后，棕褐、蓝、铜和褪绿的层叠笔痕在墙上卷曲纠结，像旧颜料、石面和烟。上方角落与帽旁肌理尤为活跃，面孔虽有明显笔触，却保持更完整的平面。光从左上照到脸，抬亮左眉与鼻梁，让右脸颊落进更深更冷的影里。背景没有清楚房间或地平线，只有紧靠人物的浅空间、密集处理过的表面。刮擦线条、小块厚涂和透明磨擦区域让图像具有不安的手工质量。肖像的正面性足以使人感到直接面对，但偏离中心的视线又把注意力引出画外。整体构图充满心理紧张，静止的深衣人物被不稳定颜色和卷曲线条包围。
style_prompt_en: The painting has expressive oil texture, with angular focal planes surrounded by curling scraped strokes and mottled color. Ocher, smoky blue, tarnished copper, cream, and near-black interweave in a narrow, weathered palette. Firmer dark outlines hold a central form, while the surrounding marks bend and overlap without clear depth, making the background restless. Light from one upper side picks out raised planes and lets opposite edges sink into cooler shadow. Thin glazed passages coexist with rougher impasto and visible abrasion, so the surface never appears polished. The overall effect is intense, introspective, and hand-worked.
style_prompt_zh: 绘画具有表现性的油画肌理，棱角分明的焦点平面被卷曲刮擦笔触和斑驳色彩包围。赭色、烟蓝、暗铜、奶油色和近黑在狭窄而风化的色域中交织。较坚实的深轮廓稳住中央形体，周围痕迹弯曲重叠，却没有清楚纵深，使背景不安。上方单侧光照出凸起平面，让对侧边缘沉入更冷的阴影。薄罩染同粗厚涂和明显磨擦共存，表面从不显得抛光。整体效果强烈、内省且带手工痕迹。
theme_en: A gaunt man in a dark hat before a swirling weathered wall
theme_zh: 戴深色帽的清瘦男子站在旋动斑驳的墙前
name: Billy Childish
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
